aliases.name: Dangling Maker
aliases.note: Deliberately wrong: slugifies to `dangling-maker`, which is a different entry in this fixture set. An alias may not name another entry — it would claim this arm goes by that one's name, and the redirect it asks for is dropped rather than shadowing a real page. Found in production when the HK416 kept claiming M27 IAR after the M27 became its own entry.
